* **So that** high-cost LLM inference loops and deep sandbox runtimes are not scheduled.

- **NFR-2 (Financial Guardrail):** Token burn must remain precisely $0.00 per static ingestion, preserving the $>80\%$ gross margin floor (`SOP-001`).
- **NFR-3 (Isolation):** Read-only sandboxing enforced per `SOP-002`; no network egress allowed during AST parsing.

       │
       ▼ (Event: REPO_INGEST_TRIGGERED)
[State: TREE_INTROSPECTION]
       │
       ├─► (Condition: Manifests Found) ───────► [State: FULL_SANDBOX_PIPELINE]
       │
       └─► (Condition: Zero Manifests / Static) ─► [State: FAST_PATH_INDEXING]
                                                        │

                                                 [State: BENCHMARK_READY]
                                                        │
                                                        ▼ (Event: LOG_COMPLETION)
                                                 [State: TERMINAL_SUCCESS]
```
*Terminal states are strictly bounded: `TERMINAL_SUCCESS` (indexed as static control) or `TERMINAL_ERROR` (malformed git tree).* 

---

| Action | Risk Tier | Founder Approval Trigger | Automated Fallback |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Ingest & Classify `octocat/Hello-World` | **Tier 1 (Low)** | None (Auto-ratified) | Fallback to cached metadata if Git fetch fails |
| Re-route static repo to LLM inference | **Tier 2 (Medium)** | Required if estimated cost > $0.05 | Default to zero-token static parser |
| Modify Core Microkernel Ingestion Rules | **Tier 3 (High)** | Mandatory Founder Confirmation | Reject configuration change |

---

## 7. Telemetry & UX Friction Points

- **Telemetry Metric 1:** `static_repo_bypass_ratio` (Target: > 99.9% accuracy for static fixtures).
- **Telemetry Metric 2:** `fast_path_parse_duration_ms` (Target: P95 < 15ms).
- **UX Friction Point:** Users expecting code analysis on documentation-only repos. *Mitigation:* Explicit UI banner: *"Repository identified as static reference documentation. Ingestion completed with zero compute burn."*
